annotations.title: Checks Agoreum sells, with prices and how to call them

description: List the services Agoreum runs itself: prompt-injection screening, MCP server, x402 endpoint, ERC-8004 agent and USDC payment checks, and payment-backed feedback. Each comes with its marketplace price, its direct x402 price and URL, an example input and its input schema. Direct calls need no Agoreum account. Use it when an agent needs one of these checks before it reads, pays or trusts something; search_services finds what other providers sell. Read-only. Settlement is on Base, a live network. The USDC here is real money and transfers are irreversible.
name: list_agoreum_tools
